How to Delete a FeetFinder Account

Deletion is a sequence, not a switch. The plan you already paid for runs to its end, and money still owed to you is supposed to leave before the profile does.

Dark-Ero editorialUpdated 2026-11-1018+

At a glance

Open the Profile tab and press Delete, then wait out any subscription that is already paid.

Unpaid earnings are paid out before the account is removed.

A plan-only cancellation has no published self-serve steps, so you email support.

Key takeaways

  • Request a payout of any balance you can withdraw before you start, once it is at least $30.
  • Save your own photos, and check that the payout details are still right.
  • US sellers are paid through Segpay, and sellers outside the US through Paxum, with Masspay also offered.
  • The card line reads SEGPAY.COM*FeetFinder, which can linger until a plan expires.
  • Never give the password to someone who offers to close the account for you.

You can delete a FeetFinder account yourself from the Profile tab. The company has said the account comes down only after current subscriptions expire and unpaid earnings are sent.

The fuller click path is in how to delete your FeetFinder account. If the button fails, the support address is hello@feetfinder.com, with your username and the email on the account.

Signing back in, if you are not ready to leave, is covered in our FeetFinder login guide. Deletion and a forgotten password are different problems.

What deletion actually does

The account does not vanish when you press the button. Active subscriptions keep running until the period you already paid for ends, and only then is the profile removed.

Before you press it, request a payout of whatever balance you can withdraw, and check the payout method. Save copies of your own photos and videos, and tell regular buyers if you want the exit to be polite.

Email hello@feetfinder.com if the Profile tab does not finish the job. Say what you tried, and include the username, because a stranger on social media who offers to close it is not the help desk.

Cancel the plan, or delete

Canceling means you stop paying for a plan and may want to keep the username. Deleting removes the account, which is the route FeetFinder has actually published.

FeetFinder has not published a separate self-serve path for canceling a plan only. To stop the subscription and keep the account, email hello@feetfinder.com, name the plan, and ask for a written confirmation of the date it ends.

Keep the account if you might come back and want the same name. Delete it if you are finished, and expect the current period to run out as part of that process.

If you are switching shops rather than quitting the work, the fee map is our FeetFinder review. Read the payout floor before you move a catalogue.

The shelf of other options is feet marketplaces. A new shop is a new ID check, not a rename of this one.

Earnings and the statement

Payouts are not automatic. You request one once the available balance reaches the $30 minimum, an admin reviews it, and the money is released within 3 to 5 business days, with no daily or weekly cap on requests.

Sellers in the US are paid through Segpay, and sellers outside the US through Paxum. Masspay is also available, and you should not remove a payout method while a balance is still sitting there.

Sellers keep 85 percent of each sale on Basic and 90 percent on Premium. Basic is $4.99 a month and Premium is $14.99 a month, with yearly and lifetime options beside them.

Charges show on statements as SEGPAY.COM*FeetFinder. If that line appears after you decided to leave, a subscription may still be running to its expiry, and the billing question goes to hello@feetfinder.com with the date and the amount.

The same statement habit shows up on larger creator sites, which is why our OnlyFans review is worth reading before you move a catalogue. Closing one login does not close the next.

A password that was shared is a reason to reset before you delete. The browser side of that is browser hygiene for private adult browsing, mostly so a shared machine does not keep the session.

The ranking site's login note is FeetFinder login. Use it if you cannot reach the Profile tab at all.

People who want the same exit on a bigger platform can follow how to delete your OnlyFans account. The buttons differ, and the idea is the same: money out, then the profile.

Do not pay a stranger who says they can force the closure. The scam shapes are in how to sell feet pics without getting scammed.

The fee context on the ranking site is the FeetFinder review. A lower plan does not close an account faster.

Verdict

Delete from the Profile tab, let the paid period end, and make sure the last payout has a working destination. A plan you might reuse is an email to support, not the delete button.

Keep the password to yourself until the account is actually gone. This is general information for adults, and the shop's own screen is the final instruction.

FAQ

How do I delete my FeetFinder account?

Sign in, open the Profile tab and press Delete. Subscriptions run until they expire, unpaid earnings are paid out, and then the account is removed.

Can I cancel the plan and keep the account?

FeetFinder has not published a separate cancel-only button. Email hello@feetfinder.com, name the plan, and ask them to confirm when it stops.

Do I lose unpaid earnings if I delete?

Unpaid earnings are paid out before the account is removed. You can also request a payout yourself once the balance reaches $30.

What is the payout minimum?

The published minimum is $30, and approved payouts are released within 3 to 5 business days. There is no daily or weekly cap on how many requests you make.

What does FeetFinder look like on a statement?

The line reads SEGPAY.COM*FeetFinder. A charge after you meant to leave can be a subscription still running to its end date.

Will support ask for my password to delete the account?

No, email hello@feetfinder.com and keep the password. Anyone who needs the password to close the account is not support.
